meta.name: DimmableFlashlight
meta.description: Adds flashlight brightness-level control. Supported levels and the maximum level are read-only capabilities. Brightness can be adjusted only while the light is on and the resource is available. Out-of-range levels or unavailable resources cause rejection. Arbitrary percentages are not treated as natively supported brightness precision.

brightness_level.description: Currently selected native flashlight brightness level. This simulated device supports each whole level from 1 through 5, and the selection persists when the flashlight is turned off.

supported_levels.description: Read-only capability records for the native discrete brightness levels supported by this simulated flashlight, keyed by level ID.

maximum_level.description: Read-only maximum native brightness level supported by this simulated flashlight.

get_brightness_level.description: Return the currently selected native flashlight brightness level without changing it.

brightness_level.description: The currently selected native brightness level from 1 through 5.

set_brightness_level.description: Set the flashlight to a supported native brightness level from 1 through 5. Adjustment is allowed only while the flashlight is actually on and the resource remains available and authorized. Unsupported or out-of-range levels and failed preconditions are rejected before any state change; arbitrary percentages are not accepted.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: Brightness can be adjusted only while the flashlight is on and its resource is available and authorized.
errorcodes.INVALID_ARGUMENT: The requested level is not one of the supported native brightness levels 1 through 5.

get_supported_levels.description: Return the read-only dictionary of native discrete brightness levels supported by this simulated flashlight.

supported_levels.description: Read-only capability records keyed by supported brightness-level ID.

get_maximum_level.description: Return the read-only maximum native brightness level supported by this simulated flashlight.

maximum_level.description: The maximum supported native brightness level.

turn_on.description: Turn on the flashlight at its currently selected native brightness level. The operation succeeds only when the light resource is available and system authorization is granted. A failed precondition leaves the actual light state unchanged and is not reported as successful.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: The flashlight resource is unavailable or system authorization is not granted.
